subject: Coordinating architecture-focused demo with FinSight engineering & procurement

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + architecture-focused demo — availability and attendees

Tom —

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. FinSight's use case (high-throughput embeddings + low-latency inferences for document search) is exactly the type of workload Priyom and our SE team love to dig into. We'd like to run a 60–75 minute architecture-focused demo for your engineering and procurement/security stakeholders so we can:

- Walk through integration patterns (API vs private deployment)
- Show latency and cost tuning levers (batching, KV cache)
- Surface security and compliance artifacts you asked about (SOC 2 scope, VPC options)

Can you confirm who from engineering, security/compliance, and procurement would attend? Tentative attendees we recommend from our side: Priyom (SE) to lead the technical walkthrough, me (AE) for commercial context, and Marissa (sales leadership) to join for procurement items if needed.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Wed Mar 24: 10:00–11:15 or 14:30–15:45
- Thu Mar 25: 09:00–10:15 or 13:00–14:15

If none of those work, send a couple of slots that do. I'm attaching a short product map and example agenda so folks can prep.

Attachments: FinSight-MAP.pdf (proposal-stub)

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

—Aditya

2) Any SSO/IDP details (Okta/Azure AD) or blocked ports we should be aware of?
